chapter.verse: Hih pen Abraham' suan David, David' suan Jesu Khris ii khanggui laibu ahi hi.
Abraham' tapa Isaac, Isaac' tapa Jacob, Jacob' tapa Judah leh a sanggamte,
Judah' tapa (Tamar tawh a neih) Perez leh Zerah, Perez' tapa Hezron, Hezron' tapa Ram,
Ram' tapa Amminadab, Amminadab' tapa Nahshon, Nahshon' tapa Salmon,
Salmon' tapa (Rahab tawh a neih) Boaz, Boaz' tapa (Ruth tawh a neih) Obed, Obed' tapa Jesse,
Jesse' tapa kumpi David ahi hi. David' tapa pen (Uriah' zi tawh a neih) Solomon hi a,
Solomon' tapa Rehoboam, Rehoboam' tapa Abijah, Abijah' tapa Asaph,
Asaph' tapa Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat' tapa Joram, Joram' tapa Uzziah,
Uzziah' tapa Jotham, Jotham' tapa Ahaz, Ahaz' tapa Hezekiah,
Hezekiah' tapa Manasseh, Manasseh' tapa Amon, Amon' tapa Josiah,
Josiah' tapa pen Babylon saltan huna piang Jeconiah leh a sanggamte ahi uh hi.
Babylon saltan khit, Jeconiah' tapa Shealtiel hi a, Shealtiel' tapa Zerubbabel,
Zerubbabel' tapa Abiud, Abiud' tapa Eliakim, Eliakim' tapa Azor,
Azor' tapa Zadok, Zadok' tapa Achim, Achim' tapa Eliud,
Eliud' tapa Eleazar, Eleazar' tapa Matthan, Matthan' tapa Jacob ahi hi.
Jacob' tapa Joseph hi a, Joseph pen Khris a kici Jesu' pianna Mary ii pasal ahi hi.
Tua hi a, Abraham pan David dong khang vekpi gawm sawmleli, David pan Babylon saltan hun dong khang sawmleli, leh Babylon saltan hun pan Khris dong khang sawmleli ahi hi.
Tu-in Jesu Khris a suahna thu hih bang ahi hi. A nu Mary pen Joseph' ading zuthawl a kipiak khit, a kiten ma-un Kha Siangtho tungtawnin naupaai ahihlam amahmah kithei hi.
A pasal ding ahi Joseph pen midik khat hi a, Mary mindaisak nuam lo ahih manin mak sim dingin ngaihsun hi.

Tua thu a geel laitak, en un, a mang sungah Topa' vanmi khat kilangin hopih a, “David' tapa Joseph aw, Mary a sunga a paai pen Kha Siangtho' kiangpana hong pai ahih manin amah zi-in la ngamlah kei in.
Amah in tapa khat nei ding a, a min Jesu na phuak ding hi; a hang pen amah in a mipihte a mawhna uh pan honkhia ding hi,” ci hi.
Hihte a bupin kamsangpa tungtawna Topa' gensa, a nuai-a thu a tangtun nading ahi hi:
“En un! Nungak gai-in tapa khat suak ding a, a min Emmanuel ci ding uh hi.” (Emmanuel a khiatna “eite tawh Pasian hong omkhawm” cihna hi.)
Joseph a ihmutna pan a khanlawh ciangin Topa' vanmi' vaikhak bangin sem hi. A zi tenpih a,
ahi zongin tapa a suah mateng nupa omkhopna neihpih lo hi. A suah ciangin a min Jesu phuak hi.
